comment: Oracle-text / type-line patterns used by the Bracket Tuner replacement pool to match a cut card with candidates filling the same role, plus the Scryfall search query used to find replacement candidates for that role. The analyzer's own category detectors (src/lib/analysis.ts) remain the source of truth for the health score; these are a data-driven mirror usable server-side.

oracle: search your library for a card
search your library for an? (artifact|creature|enchantment|instant|sorcery|planeswalker) card
tutor.scryfallQuery: (o:"search your library for a card" or o:"search your library for an artifact card") mv<=4 -is:gamechanger

oracle: search your library for (up to \w+ )?(a |an )?[\w'’, ]*(land|forest|plains|island|swamp|mountain) cards?
ramp.scryfallQuery: (t:artifact o:"{T}: Add" mv<=3 or o:"search your library for a basic land card" mv<=3)

boardwipe.scryfallQuery: (o:"destroy all creatures" or o:"exile all creatures") mv<=6

wincon.scryfallQuery: (o:"you win the game" or (t:creature mv>=6 kw:trample))

land.scryfallQuery: t:land -t:basic (o:"add one mana of any color" or o:"enters tapped")
